title: Angular Entry Point Options Schema
description: Creates a new secondary entry point in an Angular library project.

name.description: The name of the secondary entry point (for example, 'testing' or 'feature/sub').
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the secondary entry point?

project.description: The name of the library project where the secondary entry point should be added. If not specified, the CLI will determine the project from the current directory.

entryFile.description: The file name at which to create the secondary entry point's public API file, without the `.ts` extension.

prefix.description: A prefix to apply to generated selectors.

standalone.description: Creates a secondary entry point based upon the standalone API, without NgModules.

skipTests.description: Do not create `spec.ts` test files for the new secondary entry point.

skipTsConfig.description: Do not update `tsconfig.json` to add a path mapping for the new secondary entry point.
